name: manual_3be493
claim: When Seth, the GrokBot chief of staff, spawns multiple cloud Cursor agent instances, each instance that writes files uses its own git worktree. A local worker agent liaises between those cloud instances and the MacBook Pro Orchestrator, and the Orchestrator canonical checkout stays put. One agent verifying a claimed commit reads that commit from the canonical checkout and does not create a worktree. Before attributing a failure to the lane under review, judge local-branch divergence with scripts/git/reanchor_scan.sh . origin/main heads. The heads scope is required because the script defaults to remotes.

decisions.notes: CodeRabbit review 5325320807 comment 4110831906 on Perpetua-Tools PR 400. lesson_3c8025df4a77 named reanchor_scan.sh against origin/main and omitted the required repo path and scope. The script requires a repo path and defaults scope to remotes, so a local-branch check is scripts/git/reanchor_scan.sh . origin/main heads. The episodic mirror of the older claim stays append-only.
